eventDetail.scope: The conference will provide a platform for researchers to get recognition for their research innovations and provide wider publicity to the Institute. It serves as a multidisciplinary platform for researchers with diverse backgrounds and research interests. Specifically, the conference will spotlight emerging trends in Power, Energy & Control; Electronics, Communication & Signal Processing; Computer Networks & Machine Learning; Mechanical Systems and Mechatronics; and Applied Sciences, fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange among participants.
